## Self-review checklist

- [ ] Commit messages are meaningful (`type: summary` + details)
- [ ] Code builds locally (`cmake --build build`)
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`ctest --test-dir build`)
- [ ] `shellcheck scripts/*.sh` is clean (if scripts changed)
- [ ] `./scripts/start.sh` runs twice without errors (if orchestration changed)
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env` is not in the diff)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / INSTALL / MANUAL / Wiki) if needed
